notes: Marin Council (#35, San Rafael) was formed in 1910 and absorbed the Mill Valley and Sausalito Councils in 1918, each now recorded as its own entity and absorbed event. It has no rename history. This record previously carried the Santa Barbara / Mission chain, which belongs to council #53 (los-padres).
